MOTION TO VACATE JUDGMENT FILED BY DEFENDANT 527 BROADWAY LLIC HEARING SET FOR JAN-07-2022 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

MOTION TO VACATE JUDGMENT FILED BY IS GRANTED. CONTINUED TO JAN-07-2022 AT 1:30 PM IN 506 FOR TRIAL. PLAINTIFF CHIZHU LI IS PRESENT, ASSISTED BY CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER EDWARD CHU. DEFENDANT 527 BROADWAY LLC. IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY RAY DERINGER (BUILDING MANAGER).

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-07-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO FEB-22-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF CHIZHU LI IS PRESENT, ASSISTED BY CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER EDWARD CHU. DEFENDANT 527 BROADWAY LLC. IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY RAY DERINGER (BUILDING MANAGER). PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1800.00 (INCLUDES COST) TO THE PLAINTIFF. FAILURE TO PAY, THE COURT WILL ACCESS A $500.00 PUNITIVE DAMAGE AWARD. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE FEBRUARY 22, 2022, HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: A. DATT. NOT REPORTED. (D506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO DISMISS CASE WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-07-2021 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFFS CHIZHU LI AND XIANU GUAN ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT 527 BROIADAY LLC IS NOT PRESENT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
